properties.rationale: Accepted at component granularity for now, but recorded with a caveat rather than a clean yes: cap:onboarding is allocated to cmp:skills, which carries a passing check, so the detector reads it as verified one hop away — while in fact the onboarding skill has not been written at all. This is the same detector generosity noted on cap:fork-alternatives (BL-70): allocation to a checked component makes an unbuilt capability read as covered. It is not evidence of anything. When BL-101 is built, give it its own verification rather than inheriting the component's.
